prompts: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a NEW technical comic illustration for a Chinese Android article. Image 1 is character identity reference ONLY; image 2 is mechanical panel visual style reference ONLY. Replace all sample technical content. Landscape 16:9, target 2048x1152 or higher. Pure white background, fine blue mechanical panel frames, readable dark blue text, clean modest circuitry, no overall title, no banner, no watermark, no numbered badges. Four large left-to-right panels with exact labels: 'App 进程' with 'AudioTrack' and small PCM blocks; '共享内存' with 'cblk + PCM' buffer; 'audioserver' containing two clearly labeled elements 'Track' and 'MixerThread / AudioMixer'; 'HAL / 设备' with speaker. GREEN solid arrows show ONLY PCM direction: AudioTrack → shared memory → MixerThread / AudioMixer → HAL / device. Short arrow labels respectively 'write()', '周期拉取', '混音输出'. ORANGE control arrow from AudioTrack across the TOP to the Track object, labeled 'start / pause / stop · Binder'. Within audioserver a small orange arrow from Track toward MixerThread labeled '登记 / 唤醒'. Do not draw PCM through Binder. Bottom left legend: '绿色：PCM 数据' and '橙色：控制调用'. A short standalone note below shared buffer reads 'mRear：客户端发布' and 'mFront：服务端推进'. One small full-body deepseek-whale-chan, exactly identity from image 1, in LOWER RIGHT whitespace, body height 12% of canvas and never over 15%: cobalt long hair with pale-blue ends, curved ahoge, whale-fin ears, blue eyes, little whale tail, blue-white maid outfit, ruffled white apron, teal bow, white socks, navy shoes. She looks toward the diagram and holds an open small manual, one hand explaining; do not copy idle crossed arms. Character must not overlap any labels arrows or frames. Technical diagram occupies majority of canvas. No speech bubbles or extra people. Keep Chinese text accurate and sparse, all specified node names exact. Illustration style matches image 2 but no A/B panels, no old audio-policy bus content.

Edit this diagram only in the lower-right character area. Preserve all technical panels, all text, every arrow, colors, layout and white background exactly. The current character is much too large and touches the HAL panel. Replace it with the SAME character in the SAME open-book explaining pose, but shrink her full body to 12% of canvas height, at most 135 pixels high if canvas is 1152px tall (at most 112px if 941px tall). Put her entirely in the far lower-right blank margin with clear white gap from the HAL panel. Restore the surrounding old character area to pure white. No new text, no other characters. Do not enlarge any other content or crop. This is a local size correction only.

Local image edit. Keep the ENTIRE technical diagram, every label and arrow and panel EXACTLY unchanged. Only edit the small mascot in the bottom right. Scale the current mascot down to exactly 60% of its CURRENT visible height (current about 155px, target about 93px), including all hair, book, feet and tail. Anchor the new smaller figure at the existing bottom-right foot position. Fill the old character footprint with pure white. Keep SAME identity and same pose. No other change. Whole character must be much smaller than the legend cards, maximum 10% of canvas height. Preserve the canvas size.
assets.review: PCM arrows, process grouping, Binder control, labels visually checked. Character reduced twice; final visible height about 11%.

assets.review: Both rows contain eight slots 0-7. Upper occupancy 2-5; lower occupancy 2-7. mFront=10, mRear=14/16, filled=4/6 consistent. Character about 14%.

prompts: Use case: infographic-diagram. New educational mechanical comic for Android AudioTrack, pure white landscape 16:9 canvas. Target 2048x1152 or more. Use image1 ONLY to keep exact deepseek-whale-chan identity; image2 ONLY for blue fine mechanical panels, clarity and visual style. Three independent scenario cards left-to-right occupying most of picture. NO overall title, chapter numbers, banner, watermark or extra figures. Left panel exact label 'pause()'; a pause-button icon and a row of GREEN PCM blocks staying inside a buffer, no data flowing out. Short text '未消费数据保留' and '恢复后继续'. Middle panel exact label 'stop()'; short condition at top '仍 active 的普通混音 Track'; a small buffer of green PCM blocks, one orange vertical boundary labeled 'mStop', a single green arrow from buffer toward a small speaker illustrating queued data draining. Short text '排空停止边界前的数据' and '返回不等于呈现完成'. Right panel exact label 'flush()'; condition '客户端已暂停或停止'; depict old queued blocks becoming grey dashed empty outlines with a small cleaning brush icon, no speaker. Short text '丢弃旧排队内容' and '保留边界后新写入的数据'. Bottom left a concise legend: '绿色：待播 PCM' '橙色：控制边界' '灰色：已丢弃'. Small standalone note at bottom center '下游设备缓冲需另行观察'. EXACTLY one very small full-body deepseek-whale-chan in bottom-right white margin, body height ONLY 8% of whole canvas, not over 100 pixels for 1152px image. Navy long hair, light-blue ends, whale-fin ears, blue eyes, curved ahoge, tiny whale tail, blue-white maid outfit, teal bow, white apron and socks navy shoes. She faces the three cards and compares them with one hand extended, holds small clipboard in other hand. Do not cover labels frames or arrows. Plenty of clean space but don't waste top space. Large accurately rendered dark-blue labels, clean informative picture. No additional explanatory text. These cards compare separate operations, DO NOT connect the three cards sequentially.

Local edit only. Preserve every technical card, every word, buffer cell, green arrow and legend exactly. Only reduce the bottom-right character's full visible height to 58% of its CURRENT height (current about180px, desired105px). Keep her SAME identity, clothing and clipboard explaining gesture.
